WITH college_counts AS (
    SELECT c.college_id, c.state, COUNT(pc.player_id) AS player_count
    FROM player_college AS pc
    JOIN college AS c ON c.college_id = pc.college_id
    GROUP BY c.college_id, c.state
), college_metrics AS (
    SELECT college_id, state, player_count,
           AVG(player_count) OVER () AS overall_average,
           SUM(player_count) OVER () AS overall_total
    FROM college_counts
)
SELECT state,
       AVG(player_count) AS average_college_count,
       AVG(player_count * 1.0 / overall_average) AS average_relative_count,
       AVG(player_count * 1.0 / overall_total) AS average_share_of_total
FROM college_metrics
GROUP BY state
ORDER BY state
